# aj user

Look people up.


## `aj user search`

Find people by name or email.

```text
aj user search QUERY [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `QUERY` | required | Part of a name or email. |
| `-l`, `--limit` `INTEGER` | `50` | Show at most this many results. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--csv` |  | Print CSV. |


## `aj user view`

Show a person's profile (yours by default).

```text
aj user view [WHO] [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `WHO` | `@me` | @me, email, account id or name. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
